title: Court record key: a publisher's errata list
description: spec/court-record-key.md section 13.4. Append-only: each published version holds every entry of the one before, unchanged and in the same order, and seq numbers the entries 1, 2, ... with no gaps, which this schema can't check.

publisher.description: An absolute URI naming the publisher

entries.description: The corrections, in the order they were made

error.description: wrong-decision: minted for the wrong decision; wrong-facts: computed from facts that were wrong

replaced_by.description: The key that replaces it, which the corrected key redirects to

target.description: An alias (spec section 11.1) of the decision the key resolves to from then on

decision-key.description: A decision key: spec section 2.2's regex without a part or a revision; the validity rules of section 2.3 still apply
